title: Plasma Orb Spell
description: A glowing plasma orb sits on a dark pedestal, emitting vibrant neon streams of pink, purple, yellow, green and blue that drip like liquid light. The orb's core pulses with bright energy while magical green and purple smoke swirls in the dark background above a wooden surface with spilled colorful drips.
prompt: A mystical glowing plasma orb mounted on a black pedestal, radiating bright neon streams of pink, purple, yellow, green and blue light that melt and drip downwards like liquid energy. The central orb has a bright core with branching tendrils, surrounded by swirling green and purple magical smoke and symbols in a dark cosmic background, with colorful liquid dripping onto the wooden surface below, vibrant surreal fantasy style
